history.v3_verdict: All predeclared rules passed except the V11-stress added-false-admission limit: 23/19,200 versus a maximum of 19/19,200.
history.v4_amendment: Reject a recovery when the minimum shape-mismatch candidate is either endpoint of the yaw interval. A constrained boundary optimum requests a yaw outside the belief's declared support.

data_boundary.authorized_population: All 9,600 Stage-06 commissioning_fit camera opportunities, including detector misses and non-positive references.
data_boundary.independence_statement: The already-opened final audit is not independent validation of this adapter and is prohibited from selection.
data_boundary.audit_role: Commissioning-only deterministic robustness diagnostic; perturbation draws are not independent replicates.

adapter.name: interior shape-only nuisance-yaw hull admission
adapter.fallback_trigger: Only when every point-yaw refusal reason is width_mismatch or height_mismatch.
adapter.sample_rule: Uniform deterministic odd grid including mean and endpoints.
adapter.candidate_rule: At least one grid candidate must pass every unchanged Stage-06 criterion.
adapter.selection_rule: Choose passing candidate minimizing squared log width-ratio plus squared log height-ratio; tie-break by absolute yaw displacement.
adapter.boundary_rule: Refuse if that optimum is the lower or upper interval endpoint.
adapter.position_rule: Do not search x/y; retain timestamp-matched belief x/y.
adapter.measurement_rule: Use nuisance yaw only for analytic equivalent-position correction and frozen Stage-07 features.
adapter.heading_update: Position only; never update or publish heading.

covariance_scoring.R2C: Score Stage-07 measurement minus ground truth with R2C.
covariance_scoring.Pxy_plus_R2C: Score Stage-07 measurement minus perturbed prior with Pxy+R2C.

reporting: Complete counts by regime, camera and spatial block.
Precision, reference-positive recall, added false admissions and Stage-07 error summaries.
R2C residual and Pxy+R2C innovation containment.
Immutable per-opportunity ledger and named Camera-D sliver verdict.
prohibitions: Do not change detector confidence or Stage-06 hull thresholds.
Do not fit/refit Stage-07 correction or covariance.
Do not use final-audit data for selection.
Do not call perturbation rows independent samples or replicates.
Do not launch final campaign unless V4 audit and a fresh end-to-end preflight pass.
